- Legal entity name for invoicing: Company is registered as "Blue Gate Systems, Inc." but our marketplace listing currently uses "BlueGate Systems" — will that be an issue for PO and tax matching?
- Preferred billing entity and mailing address for invoices
- Required tax docs for a US-entity (we can provide W-9)

- Any vendor intake form or marketplace-specific registration steps you need from us (DUNS, primary contact, technical contact, SKU mapping)

Hi Alicia — welcome, and thanks for the clear list.

Short answer: the onboarding steps depend on which marketplace and the invoice entity that will appear on the PO. To avoid a PO rejection we usually need:

1) Legal entity exact match (the name on the PO must match your invoicing/legal name). If your marketplace listing uses a shorter trade name, we'll need an invoice alias mapping and a signed W-9 showing the legal name.
2) Vendor intake form (attached) completed + DUNS(optional) + point-of-contact for finance and technical.
3) Banking details or confirmation that you prefer wiring on the first invoice — we can open the PO and route to accounting once we have the wiring stub.
4) For AWS/Azure/GCP specifically: please indicate which marketplace you plan to use for billing (some customers require billing through the cloud provider, others want direct billing). We support both patterns but it affects the invoice flow.

I've attached Redwood's vendor intake template with the fields we need filled. Vanessa (CC'd) is our FinOps lead and will confirm any tax doc requirements. Ben is on sales and will coordinate SKU mapping for the marketplace listing.

Next steps: can you return the completed intake + signed W-9 + bank wiring stub? If you can send those by EOD tomorrow we'll mirror them in our activation tracker and request PO issuance from the buyer. Typical vendor verification turnaround is 2-3 business days once docs are complete.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Partner Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_vendor_intake_template.pdf

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>

Date: 2025-05-23T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Getting set up on AWS/Azure/GCP marketplaces — initial intake

Hi Alicia — Vanessa here (FinOps). Quick follow-ups after reviewing the draft:

- We need a W-9 that matches the legal entity exactly as it will appear on the PO. If your legal name is "Blue Gate Systems, Inc." the PO must use that full name. If you want your listing to show "BlueGate Systems" to customers, we'll record a DBA/alias for display but the invoice must match the legal entity for accounting.
- Please confirm your TAX ID (EIN) on the W-9 and that it's the same entity that will receive payment. If the EIN belongs to a parent company, we'll need a certificate of authority or invoice routing confirmation.
- For bank wiring: provide a bank wiring instructions PDF (bank name, account holder name, account number, routing/ABA, SWIFT). We'll treat the wiring instruction as an attachment and mark the account as verified after a micro-deposit check.
- If you are targeting AWS Marketplace with buyer billing through AWS, expect an additional 1-week delay for revenue share verification; we can parallelize our vendor verification but will flag the timeline to the buyer.

Low-friction approach: send the completed intake form + signed W-9 + wiring stub to me and cc stephanie. We'll do the legal/name reconciliation and reply with the exact PO name to use.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, FinOps | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

(note: kimberly - CC'd - will spot any gaps in the vendor legal paperwork for EU VAT cases).

Hi Alicia — got everything, thank you. Quick summary and next actions so the buyer's procurement team can issue the PO without extra churn:

- Legal entity for PO: Blue Gate Systems, Inc. (confirmed via W-9). Please ensure any internal buyer docs use that exact string.
- We've received the wiring stub and will mark the account for verification. For the buyer: Redwood will include bank details with the initial invoice; after the micro-deposit verification we can accept future wires to the same account.
- Marketplace routing: please confirm if you want Redwood to enable provider-billed (e.g., AWS Marketplace) or direct-billed (invoice from Blue Gate Systems, Inc.). If you reply with the preference we'll record it in HS-8421 and flag the buyer.
- Timeline: vendor verification + PO name reconciliation complete by 2025-05-29 if no further questions. Once PO is received, engineering will schedule SKU onboarding (Ben will reach out re: marketplace mapping).
